name: That is all i want
source:
What is normality, and what are its limits? The protagonist V Volsteir will try to answer this question for you! Embark on the journey of becoming an ordinary person, experience moments of their downfall and triumphs, all while preventing them from spiraling into madness amid the chaos of unfolding events.

The key is  ̶t̶o̶ ̶i̶g̶n̶o̶r̶e̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶s̶h̶a̶d̶o̶w̶s̶ ̶t̶h̶a̶t̶ ̶o̶c̶c̶a̶s̶i̶o̶n̶a̶l̶l̶y̶ ̶s̶t̶i̶r̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶c̶o̶r̶n̶e̶r̶s̶,̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶f̶a̶i̶n̶t̶ ̶b̶r̶u̶s̶h̶ ̶a̶g̶a̶i̶n̶s̶t̶ ̶y̶o̶u̶r̶ ̶s̶h̶o̶u̶l̶d̶e̶r̶ ̶w̶h̶e̶n̶ ̶n̶o̶ ̶o̶n̶e̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶b̶e̶h̶i̶n̶d̶ ̶y̶o̶u̶.̶ ̶A̶n̶d̶ ̶y̶o̶u̶ ̶c̶e̶r̶t̶a̶i̶n̶l̶y̶ ̶s̶h̶o̶u̶l̶d̶n̶’̶t̶ ̶t̶r̶y̶ ̶t̶o̶ ̶d̶e̶c̶i̶p̶h̶e̶r̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶w̶o̶r̶d̶s̶ ̶a̶n̶d̶ ̶n̶u̶m̶b̶e̶r̶s̶ ̶s̶p̶i̶l̶l̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶f̶r̶o̶m̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶m̶o̶u̶t̶h̶s̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶c̶r̶e̶a̶t̶u̶r̶e̶s̶ ̶t̶h̶a̶t̶ ̶l̶o̶o̶k̶ ̶a̶l̶m̶o̶s̶t̶ ̶h̶u̶m̶a̶n̶ enjoy the ride!
